test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The second schedule of the Indian constitution deals with:

options.text: Allocation of seats in council of states
Salary of President, Governors, Chief Judges, Judges of High Court and Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**Salary of President, Governors, Chief Judges, Judges of High Court and Supreme Court**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Second Schedule of the Indian Constitution specifies the emoluments for the highest constitutional offices in India.
 
• This schedule details the salaries and allowances of the President, Governors, Judges of Supreme Court and High Courts, and the Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
 
• The intention is to ensure that these key officials receive fair remuneration that reflects their responsibilities and the importance of their roles in governance.
 
• Amendments to this schedule can be made by the Parliament as per Article 360 of the Indian Constitution, ensuring that the salaries remain relevant and appropriate over time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Forms of oaths and affirmations:**

 
 
• These are covered under the Third Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It includes the oaths or affirmations for Union Ministers, Parliament members, judges, etc.
 
 
 
• **List of states & union territories:**
 
 
• These are described in the First Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It provides details on the territories of the states and union territories, including any changes to their boundaries.
 
 
 
• **Allocation of seats in council of states:**
 
 
• This is outlined in the Fourth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It specifies the number of seats allotted to each state and union territory in the Rajya Sabha (Council of States).
 
 
 
• **Salary of President, Governors, Chief Judges, Judges of High Court and Supreme Court:**
 
 
• Covered under the Second Schedule, it ensures that these important offices are compensated appropriately.
 
• This includes provisions for their pensions and allowances in addition to their salaries.
